name: Acceptance-Gate Discipline Framework + Class-C / Class-D Gate Suite
description: Establish the four-class acceptance-gate taxonomy (A latent-code / B refactor-integrity / C data-correctness / D render-fidelity) as standing org architecture, and ship the gate classes that do not exist today. A validation gate is a structural enforcement point that fires at a defined lifecycle moment, compares an artifact against a reference EXTERNAL to the code (rolling baseline / declared inventory / raw envelope / pre-refactor sentinels), and renders a PASS/WARN/BLOCK verdict. Code-level checks (py_compile, ruff, tsc, AST scan, code-walk, runtime smoke) validate the CODE; they structurally cannot catch B/C/D-class defects because the reference is not in the code. v0.1 scope: ship the Class-C data-correctness gate suite (4 gates: row-count-stability, classification-distribution-stability, sentinel-rows-present, cross-source row-content parity), ship the Class-D render-fidelity gate suite (3 gates: adapter-threading, visual-rendering-baseline, multi-axis envelope sentinel), formalize Class-B (chain-run pre/post sentinel-diff), and catalog the parity-class gate shape. Anchored on 3 empirical incidents: DWSPLT chain #27 shape-clean-but-zero-NNA scare, INFFIN 8-defect adapter-threading arc, INFGRO window-TWR arithmetic-mean defect.
